verdict.rationale: Terraform's own docs show that input variables can be supplied at apply time via `-var` and `-var-file`, which keeps values out of committed configuration. A community report also refers to 'sensitive variables' in Terraform Cloud/Enterprise and notes that secrets are stored unencrypted in state, which limits the 'not exposed' guarantee. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of sensitive-value marking and redaction from plan/apply output and logs, integration with a secrets manager, protection of secrets in state, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass secrets and sensitive configuration into deployments without exposing them in code or logs

citations.quote: Sensitive variables can't be overridden when importing in Terraform Cloud/Enterprise.
